Panchamukhi Hanuman: Paatal Mein Ahiravan Ka Ant! 🐒

🔱 Panchamukhi Hanuman five faces defeating Ahiravan patala

To extinguish five lamps hidden in five directions simultaneously and slay sorcerer demon Ahiravan in Patala Loka, Hanuman manifested his Panchamukhi form: Vanara, Narasimha, Garuda, Varaha, and Hayagriva.

👉 Panchamukhi Hanuman ka roop — har disha mein suraksha ka kavach!
